fusions.name: Mote Flick
fusions.desc: Flicks a mote that deals 4 damage and has a 30% chance to leave the target [Blunted] for 4 seconds.

fusions.name: Unseen Shot
fusions.desc: A thrown shot that deals 36 damage, up to 2 times that at maximum range. It is always a critical hit.

fusions.name: Wainscot Hush
fusions.desc: Veils you for 8 seconds. Enemies notice you far later and you move 15% faster, and the veil breaks the moment you attack.

fusions.name: Scurry Ward
fusions.desc: When your health falls below 35%, a shield worth 20% of your maximum health covers you for 5 seconds. Once every 30 seconds. You have 5% more dodge chance.
